policy: forward-evidence admission route: per-watch alpha spending on a freeze ledger (FORWARD_ROUTE_PROPOSAL.md Q1-Q5, decision-debate consensus 2026-10-09; ratified 2026-10-29)

ratified.by: delegated session; consensus default adopted by delegation (owner instruction 2026-10-29; decision debate round 2 point 7)
ratified.owner_amendable_until: the first ADMIT (H366200's anniversary 2 settles about 2029-01)

in_window_sessions_elapsed_unlogged_at_r.note: NYSE sessions 2026-10-12 .. 2026-10-29 inclusive, the ratification commit's date (nyse_calendar.sessions_between); 13 of them had closed when the debate concluded, during the 2026-10-29 session

ledger.rule: append-only (prefix), one canonical-JSON row per watch; an ID must be listed before freeze; genesis and log refuse an unlisted ID; concurrent branches take ordinals in first-parent merge order; the founding cohort predates the ledger and is grandfathered by this ratification

row.note: a row is written BEFORE the freeze, so it cannot carry the spec's hash or freeze time; the optional fields are present only for the founders, recorded at ratification. verify checks spec_sha256 only when present; for every other listed watch the spec's bytes are pinned by the registration stage (first-parent history) and by verify's rule that every spec file has a row

test.upper: LLR >= ln((1 - beta) / alpha_i), alpha and beta from the watch's own spec
test.lower: LLR <= ln(beta / (1 - alpha)), unchanged from the spec
test.beta_prime: about 0.205 at alpha_i = 0.05/3 (Wald's bound; derived, not a parameter)
test.own_promote: non-terminal; the spec's frozen consequences at its own boundary apply (H366201 closes on a long leg <= 0)

first_decisive_anniversary.new_specs: a structured evaluation.first_decisive_anniversary field is required

test.settle: anniversary k is written once, when the log holds the 64th session line past its cut, by log position
admit_requires: every corroboration condition in the spec
the chain verifies, every evaluator change is attested, no VOID

alpha_spending.alpha: the spec's alpha (0.05 for both founders)
alpha_spending.never_recycled: alpha assigned to a closed or voided watch is never reassigned; a later policy, frozen before its window, may reshape only the unassigned tail
alpha_spending.honest_statement: ordinal 3's boundary is 5.257 nats (4.5% by 40 years at a true Sharpe of 0.3); from ordinal 3 on a watch is a record, not a practical admission path

admission_grants: eligibility as a sleeve; no size

sizing.host: TR-20261006T005053Z-9336581d#0 (the D6 static 60/40 SPY/IEF reference, 21 tranches, tier1)
sizing.sleeve: the watch's recorded 1x-cost tilt book (benchmark + active), full recorded books
sizing.mix: m_t = (1 - x) p_t + x s_t, rebalanced each session to fixed weights; carve pro rata from the 60/40
sizing.alpha_input: the stagewise-ordering 80% lower confidence bound for the frozen route design, by seeded simulation
sizing.excess_sharpe: mean over standard deviation of (r - DTB3), daily, x sqrt(252)
sizing.drawdown: nominal maximum drawdown on the daily close path, daily compounding, measured within each window from its first session
sizing.extra_drawdown: maxDD(mix) - maxDD(host) in the same window; the maximum over the three windows binds
sizing.rule: the largest x on the grid that raises the excess Sharpe in both regime windows and keeps the extra drawdown within the budget
sizing.record: a separate sizing record citing the ADMIT, due within 30 days of it; absent means size 0; never sized up later on the same record
sizing.proxy_extension: none unless a Q3 amendment freezes one before any ADMIT
sizing.live: paper only until the owner approves any live change

de_admission.cusum: W_k = max(0, W_{k-1} - dLLR_k), dLLR_k = t_k (theta S_k - theta^2 / 2) from year k's own sessions on the pinned anniversary windows; alarm at h = 2.0 de-admits
de_admission.close_or_void: the close boundary on the full record, or a VOID, de-admits
de_admission.drawdown_cut: checked daily on the paper path: host-with-sleeve nominal max drawdown minus the host's alone > budget_pp sets the size to 0 until a new debate

build.chain: admit_watch (tools/admit.py --watch <ID>), its own verifier, not prereg.load
stages: evaluator continuity at each line's code.sha (attestations only from development)
sequential (pinned by the log prefix's line sha)
build.witness: the log prefix is on development, witnessed_sha recorded
build.hand_written: the verifier recomputes every stage from the prefix; a hand-written ADMIT cannot verify
build.records: docs/research/verdicts/<ID>/, one per anniversary (O_EXCL), the latest governs; a DE-ADMIT state; sizing is a separate record
build.published_with_it: the route's error-rate table and the exact admission-probability figures
tests_required: an own promote is non-terminal and the route admit follows it on the same record
a late correction changes no settled verdict
deleting a branch changes no ordinal and no alpha_i (ordinals come from the ledger, not from git)
H366201's year-3 close is suppressed (first decisive anniversary 4)
a long leg <= 0 at a promote crossing closes H366201 (its frozen consequence)
a CUSUM alarm at h = 2.0 de-admits
a volatility shift alone does not trip the CUSUM

applies_to: every watch on the freeze ledger; a watch cannot admit by itself
excludes: H404702's forward window, which is the admission gate's own forward stage
